meta.name: red
meta.description: Residual re-identification RISK CHECK on text you have ALREADY redacted (defensive, dual-use). Use when the user asks to "check residual re-id risk", "red-team my redaction", "what can an attacker still infer", "is this safe to share", or assess "re-identification risk" after anonymizing. Re-runs the CONFIDE detectors on the redacted output to surface surviving identifiers (singling-out), checks multiple files for linkability, and optionally probes a local model for still-inferable attribute CATEGORIES (inference) — mapped to GDPR Art-29. Reports risk categories/counts only, never a re-identification recipe. Pairs with confide:anon (run AFTER redacting).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查已匿名文本的残留再识别风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在分享匿名数据前确认隐私风险
copy.tagline_en: Check residual re-identification risk in anonymized text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to confirm no privacy risk before sharing anonymized data

howto.what: 该技能会扫描你已经去标识的文本，重新运行检测器找出遗漏的标识符（如邮箱、电话等），跨文件检查可链接性，并可选择用本地模型推断还能推测出的属性类别（如职业、年龄段），最后报告风险等级（高/中/低）和各类计数，但不给出具体的重识别方法。
howto.when: 当用户在完成去标识后要求检查残留重识别风险时触发，例如说出“检查残留重识风险”、“对我的去标识做红队测试”、“攻击者还能推断出什么”等。

say.text: 检查这份文件还有多少重识别风险。
say.note: 运行单文件残留风险检查，报告幸存标识符和风险等级。

say.text: 对去标识后的文件夹做链接性分析。
say.note: 检查文件夹内文件间是否存在可链接的准标识符对。

say.text: 加上--inference，本地模型推测剩余属性。
